sourceRefs.title: Microsoft Learn: Set up posting groups
sourceRefs.usedFor: Posting groups map customers, vendors, items and documents to G/L accounts; incorrect setups create posting errors and should be controlled by accountants.

sourceRefs.title: Microsoft Learn: Set up calculations and posting methods for VAT
sourceRefs.usedFor: VAT setup depends on who the company trades with and what it buys/sells; VAT setup can be complex and must be checked against local requirements.

routeDecision.reason: Die verbleibenden Foundation-Gaps sind keine einzelnen Klickprobleme mehr, sondern Kontenfindungs- und USt-Einrichtungslogik. Fuer ein realistisches Kundenprojekt ist eine vorbereitete, pruefbare Setup-Feldkarte robuster als weitere blinde UI-Zellversuche auf Page 314 oder Page 472.
routeDecision.manualUiRole: Manual UI remains valuable for training, handbook explanation and single-record validation, but not as the primary route for repeated setup matrix entry until a stable editor path is proven.
routeDecision.configurationPackageRole: Use a local field map for General Posting Setup and VAT Posting Setup, then a later gated read-first/package-discovery or write-proof case can validate/import/apply only after Smart Decision, screenshots and reopen proof.
routeDecision.sourceBackedInspectionRole: Page Inspection and Microsoft Learn are allowed to confirm page/table/field meaning and product logic. They do not prove that Universaarl setup values are saved.
parkedRoutes: Repeat generic Tell-Me/Page-Inspection route for Page 470
Repeat Page 472 active-editor probes without a materially new route

realismAssessment.why: A BC consultant would define required setup combinations, ownership, source and validation first, then choose UI, assisted setup, configuration package, Excel-assisted import or API/AL route consciously.
realismAssessment.noMockupBoundary: The decision creates no fake UI evidence. Later proof must come from real playthru UI screenshots and reopen checks.

proved: The active next step is a route decision, not another completed read-first replay.
Manual UI, configuration package/import, source-backed inspection and explicit parking were compared.
For unresolved Foundation setup gaps, the selected route is to prepare a source-backed configuration-package field map before any write.
O2C, P2P, Preview Posting and Posting remain blocked until Foundation setup is bounded or proven.

Configuration packages can be realistic for setup preparation, but applying them is a write action and needs a separate Smart Decision, screenshot chain and reopen proof.
Microsoft Learn explains product logic; Universaarl playthru evidence must still prove actual local values.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: VAT Product Posting Groups, VAT Posting Setup, chart starter accounts, number series, dimensions, customer and item contexts are useful read-first evidence. VAT Business Posting Groups Page 470 and full posting/VAT setup remain unresolved; General Posting Setup is partial and not posting-ready.
nextStepDecision.reason: The local route decision was the correct next step because repeating blocked UI routes or jumping to O2C/P2P would be less realistic and less auditable.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: It creates the concrete setup field map needed before any configuration-package, import or write gate.
The as-is Page-472 editor route remains parked; no materially new editor proof exists.
Existing customer and item examples are training-ready, not process-ready.
Posting groups and VAT setup are not sufficiently bounded for document or posting evidence.

queueChangesMade: Selected FOUNDATION-SETUP-PACKAGE-FIELD-MAP as the next local no-live case.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the consultant route decision into a concrete, auditable setup map without opening BC or writing data.
risksBeforeNextCase: Treating planned setup values as proven BC values.
Overusing configuration packages without explaining manual UI and validation to learners.
Forgetting that applying/importing any package is a write action.
requiredPreparation: Use official source references and existing playthru evidence only.
Map only the minimal Foundation combinations needed before Master Data/process gates.
